verdicts.reason: A has a clear left-to-right flow: eyebrow above headline, the subtitle on one line, the date block with tags, then the RSVP button set apart on the right. Its flaws are the partner-asset placeholder colliding with the URL caption at bottom right, a tiny, hard-to-read 'solstice' logo text, and cramped tags and caption. B is worse. The placeholder sits on top of the SOLSTICE logo, 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' ends up tiny below the headline (wrong order), and the subtitle is squeezed into a 6-line sliver. The RSVP button is shrunk to tag size and lost among the FREE ENTRY/ALL AGES/TASTINGS pills, which destroys the CTA hierarchy.
